standard: BTicino / Legrand SCS Bus & Gateway Protocol

command_session.description: Used to send commands and request dimension values. Gateway executes command and responds with ACK (*#*1##) or NACK (*#*0##).

event_session.description: Used for asynchronous monitoring of the SCS bus. Gateway streams all bus frames in real time to the client.

ack.meaning: Acknowledge (Command accepted and dispatched to SCS bus)

nack.meaning: Negative Acknowledge (Command rejected, syntax error, or bus busy)

frame_types.description: Command or status event frame representing an actuation or state change on the bus.
Command translation frame used by scenario programmers or gateways.
Queries the current state of a device or subsystem.
Queries specific dimension parameter(s) from a device.
Writes values into a device dimension register.
Gateway reply to a dimension request conveying measured values or settings.

general.description: Broadcasts to all devices in the system for that WHO family.

area.description: Targets all devices belonging to room/area A.

group.description: Targets all devices programmed into group G.

point_to_point.description: Targets an individual device actuator directly.

bus_routing.syntax: WHERE#4#bus (e.g. 12#4#1 = device 12 on private SCS bus 1)
bus_routing.description: Routes frames across physical bus interfaces via F422 inter-bus couplers.

scenario_button.description: Identifies physical pushbutton numbers on multi-gang CEN/CEN+ wall plates.
